controls.evidence: The complete role log query returned four grants and no revocations: ADMIN_ROLE to this address, BURNER_ROLE to 0xf095cf0a76d6168e37e74c44b5ec11c607e14b5c, MINTER_ROLE to 0x259b74273f2a371f88cbc2cd8ca3339066600757 and MINTER_APPROVER_ROLE to 0x778b36adecb99a5a920106c441598879bfeb184c. All four have eth_getCode=0x. At block 110115443, hasRole confirms the three issuance identities; getRoleAdmin for ADMIN, MINTER, MINTER_APPROVER and UPGRADER returns ADMIN_ROLE. No UPGRADER_ROLE grant is present; the administrator can reactivate immediate audited UUPS upgrades by granting that role. This is not renunciation or timelock protection.

controls.label: Newrails EURW MINTER_ROLE EOA

sources.label: Monad mainnet hasRole and minterAllowance reads

controls.evidence: At block 110115443, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE)=true, ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_APPROVER_ROLE=false, and minterAllowance(address)=320170160000 raw units, or 320,170.16 EURW. The allowance-consuming mint path is audited; the independent approver can overwrite it. Hacken's accepted F-2026-15201 allowance-overwrite frontrunning finding prevents treating this snapshot as an immutable economic cap.

review.evidence: Monad role logs from genesis through block 110115443 close the current ADMIN/MINTER/MINTER_APPROVER roster and establish that no UPGRADER_ROLE grant exists; current role-admin reads retain the administrator's reactivation path. The proxy first has runtime code at block 61584206 (2026-03-15), in transaction 0x3fb231fb1a9045f86604727f233e9ff8885cdc6dec1e9f4f0567fa3f03592f47, and no code at 61584205. The Bank of Lithuania register and exact-token whitepaper support prudential supervision, not independent reserve assurance. Current remaining allowance is observed, not a permanent supply bound. Audited source was not publicly retrievable from the linked repository, so exact source/runtime correspondence and offchain key custody remain qualified. Independent human/key-custody arrangements for the three issuance EOAs and current exact-token financial reserve-to-liability reconciliation remain unverified; these are key-custody and Backing qualifications, not gaps in the identified signer census.
unresolvedQuestions: The current EURW proxy implementation has not been independently bound to the audited source or proven byte-for-byte equal to a verified reference. The administrator can immediately activate an upgrade authority, so exact current mint/grant/upgrade-path runtime semantics remain unverified despite the closed role roster.
